capabilities: link a Newledge account by scanning a QR code
import Newledge notes, links, highlights, and annotations as Markdown files
schedule automatic syncs or run manual syncs
write imported files to a configured vault folder
add a daily-note link property to imported notes
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English) and discloses network use: it connects to xinzhi.zone for login, verification, fetching sync content, and reporting sync status, and stores the linked account and token via Obsidian's plugin data API; it states it has no telemetry, ads, or auto-update.
problem: Newledge users have no built-in way to get their Newledge notes, highlights, and annotations into an Obsidian vault as Markdown files.

relations.evidence: Scan the QR code with the Newledge app. In the app, go to Profile > Data integration
Newledge (Xinzhi) works well with Obsidian's Daily notes core plugin.

summary: Syncs notes, links, highlights, and annotations from the Newledge (Xinzhi) app into a vault as Markdown files via QR-code account linking.
